observations.behavior: The Rust upsert implementation no longer retains metadata for every hit file, but only for up to the configured parallel file limit. This prevents metadata memory from growing with the partition's file count.
observations.posthog_connection: This could reduce memory pressure during large warehouse upserts, especially when the number of matching files is high.
